hotspots.description:
Every war begins with a sign.

Before the Rebel Ants were forced to choose sides, before the blades, the betrayals, and the battles that would shake the colony forever, there was a warning carried through the shadows.

At first, it was only a whisper. A feeling. A shift in the air. Something ancient was moving beneath the surface, and the peace the colony had known was beginning to break.

The Warning tells the beginning of the Rebel Ants saga, where loyalty is tested, enemies rise in silence, and the strongest warriors must face a truth none of them are ready for.

The colony is no longer safe.

And what comes next will decide the future of the Rebel Universe.

hotspots.description: One drawer in all the vault is sealed in red and locked. The archivists say the key was never made.
A round door of iron a hand thick. It stands open: the Buke keep their oldest records where anyone may read them, and guard them where no one may take them.
The colony's first charter, in the hands of all eleven founders: steadfast unity, and defence of the inner colonies.

hotspots.description: Twenty-seven shields, one for every family that has held the inner colonies. The trident: steadfast unity and defence.
The Buke engineers brought the canal through the hall so that no siege could cut the water off. It has never been needed.
Basins of every size by the canal, and not one mark on them. The Engineer measures water with them anyway, and asks every apprentice to do the same.

hotspots.description: A timber frame every three paces. The engineers count them: a tunnel with a missing frame is a tunnel waiting to fall.
Cut through to the gorge for light and air, and to watch the road in.
The cage rises to the cliff top on the great pulley; the winch takes four Buke to turn. The counterweight is a block from the first tunnel.

hotspots.description: The canal turns the wheel; the wheel turns the gears; the gears turn the saw and the grindstone. Nothing in the workshop is pushed by hand that water can push.
Every bridge the Buke build is built here first, small, and loaded until it breaks. Then the real one is built three times stronger.

spotConfig.label: Check the stones
spotConfig.text: The west footbridge is sound. Its stones are dry and tight.

spotConfig.label: Check the stones
spotConfig.text: Under the east footbridge, a hairline crack runs along the canal wall, pointing north.

spotConfig.label: Check the stones
spotConfig.text: The west spout is weeping water from a seam that should be dry.

spotConfig.label: Dry the drawings
spotConfig.text: The lantern's warmth lifts the damp from the paper. The tunnel lines come back, sharp and dark.

spotConfig.label: Look under the bridge
spotConfig.text: Tied under the east footbridge with fishing line: a tiny brass key stamped with the trident.
Forty metres up, the whole canyon village lies below you: canals, bastions, the great hall. The wind smells of rain.

spotConfig.label: Look at the bastion stone
spotConfig.text: Low on the bastion, half hidden by moss, the Buke trident is carved beside a date no one remembers.

spotConfig.label: Listen to the canal

requires.hint: The canal is quiet. Maybe the rain has to be loud first.

spotConfig.text: Rain hammers the canal. Under the noise you hear the water draining away somewhere far below the canal floor.

spotConfig.label: Try the drawer
spotConfig.text: A drawer at the back of the archive is locked, but its label is readable: SURVEY LINES, FIRST COLONY. Somebody has tried to scratch it off.

spotConfig.label: Look closer
spotConfig.text: A tiny ant peeks out at you.

riddles.q: A beetle falls into a dry well 10 m deep. Each day it climbs 3 m; each night it slides back 2 m. On which day does it climb out?
riddles.why: After seven days and nights it is 7 m up. On the eighth day it climbs the last 3 m and is out before night can pull it back.

riddles.q: If three ants dig three tunnels in three days, how long do nine ants take to dig nine tunnels?
riddles.why: Each ant digs one tunnel in three days. Nine ants, nine tunnels: the same three days.

riddles.q: An engineer must ferry a fox, a beetle and a sack of seeds across the canal. The raft holds the engineer and one more. Left alone, the fox eats the beetle and the beetle eats the seeds. What crosses first?
riddles.why: The fox will not touch the seeds. Take the beetle, go back for the fox, bring the beetle back, take the seeds, then fetch the beetle last.

riddles.q: Nine relic coins look alike, but one is a lighter fake. With a balance scale, what is the fewest weighings that always finds it?
riddles.why: Weigh three against three. The lighter pan, or the three left off if they balance, hides the fake. Then weigh one of those three against another.

riddles.q: Water in a canal lock doubles every minute, and the lock is full after 12 minutes. When was it half full?
riddles.why: It doubles every minute, so one minute before it was full, it was half full.
